overview: Sixteen more animals can be befriended, and will follow, wait and fight alongside you the way only a wolf could before.

1.1.0: A whistle now reaches every companion you have, wherever it is: asleep in a chunk nobody is standing in, or waiting in another dimension. Ones already at your heel stay where they stand, and anything on a lead or being ridden is left alone.

Every companion on one page, with how far off each one is and a button to let it go, plus /companions release for the one you are standing next to. Feeding a hurt companion the food that won it over mends it, and there is an advancement for the day eight of them are still behind you.
1.0.0: Crouch and offer an animal the thing it already likes, berries to a fox, bamboo to a panda, wheat to a cow, and it is yours: it follows, waits where you put it, wears armour and comes through a portal at your heels.
Pet any animal and watch it happen, and a companion told to stay gets up after a while and potters about the spot rather than standing on one block.
